div.ab: Again the book of the sessions from the book of Treasures of Mysteries. First, the book of Joshua, the son of Nun, 18 chapters.

div.head: Chapter I.
div.ab:
Chapter I. 1:1 After Moses, the servant of the Lord, had died, i.e., and it came to pass after the consummation (the end) of Moses, the servant of the Lord. i.e., the wau which is at the beginning of this book confirms the fact that Joshua the son of Nun himself, when he finished the words of the death and interment of Moses, composed this book. 1:2 My servant Moses had died, therefore rise up and cross this Jordan. i.e., Moses had died and could not bring over (lit. cause to enter) this people to the land of promise. Since neither the law and the prophets could tread the path to the kingdom of heaven, by thee (in thee) however who had taken the type of the lord Jesus, they are to enter. Crossing the Jordan is a type of baptism. After the guilt of the Amorites is completed, is the type of the power of the sin of the world all together. The Jordan (Yurdhnan) is from two springs, from Yur and Denan, and it begins from Luz the city of the sons of Dan. 1:5 I shall not neglect you nor forsake you. with Revasa of Pe and Qushshaya of Beth. 1:11 Prepare for yourselves provisions, for from now in three days you will be crossing this Jordan i.e., the manna was about to be cut off from them. 2:1 And they went and entered to (the
house) of a harlot woman whose name was Rahan. i.e., the type of the unclean gentiles who are worthy of salvation, and in order that the people of the place might think that they came to commit fornication and not to spy the land. 2:6 And she hid them among the flax-stalks. Gr. reeds of flax.

div.head: Chapter II.
div.ab:
Chapter II. 2:17 We are absolved from this oath. With Zeqafa of the latter mim in the singular form. 2:18 Bind then a scarlet thread in the window thru which you did let us down. i.e., the type of sinners who repenting are saved. Red is the sign of the humour which excites sins. 3:4 And there shall be a distance between you and the ark about two thousand cubits. i.e., as an honor for it, for in it were the tablets of law, and the staff of Aaron, and a pint of manna; and priests, and levites were carrying it on their shoulders on the way. 3:13 And as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests..... 3:13 ...shall rest in the waters of the Jordan..... 3:13 ....The waters that come down from above shall rise up as in a wine-skin into a wall. Gr. shall rise up as a pile (heap) 3:15 ...were dipped in the edge of the water. with pethaha of Teth and Beth 3:16 They were very far from Aram. Gr. Adham with Daleth. Sim. Adhum. 3:16 Which is beside Sartam. with Qushshaya of Tau. 3:16 It were cut off completely. with Revasa of Lamadh. 3:16 Then the people passed over right opposite Jericho. i.e., the type of baptism which indeed came forth there. 4:3 And prepare (you pl.)
twelve stones and carry them over with you. i.e., in Gilgal they shall be set up as a remembrance that the waters of the Jordan were divided for them. Moses did not perform that when he crossed the Red Sea by reason of the fact that he did not make them enter the land of promise all at once.

div.head: Chapter III.
div.ab:
Chapter III. 4:18 The soles of the priests' feet rested on the dry land. with Pethaha of mim and pe, and Zeqafa of Semkath and Tau. 5:2 Make thee a knife of flint Gr. stone-knives. 5:2 And return (pl) and circumcise the children of Israel the second time. i.e., he commanded to have circumcised the second generation which was not circumcised in the wilderness, and not those that were already circumcised once. 5:9 And the lord said to Joshua, this day I have caused to pass away the reproach of Egypt from you. i.e., of those that were saying that you went away from us and were not able to inherit the land. 5:10 And the children of Israel encamped in Gilgal and they made (celebrated) the pass over on the fourteenth day of the first month in the evening, in the Plain of Jericho. i.e., they prepared on the 15th to eat it; and consider the providence of God that was upon them, that the sons of Shekim who were circumcised by iron had to stay for a long time since their sickness (referring to the circumcision) was sore, but those who were circumcised with blunt flint were healed quickly. On the
tenth day they crossed the Jordan, on the eleventh they were circumcised, on the thirteenth they were healed, and on the fourteenth they celebrated the pass-over. 5:11 Unleavened bread and parched corn they ate with Revasa of Qof nest. with pethaha. Gr. unleavened bread and fresh things. 5:13 And he saw a man standing in front of him and his sword drawn i.e., Michael the angel, the leader of his nation. 5:15 And the captain of the Lord's host said unto Joshua, loosen thy sandals from thy feet, for the place where you stand is holy. i.e., that which he commanded unto Moses, he commands him (i.e., Joshua) and nothing else, that he might know that he was the same and not some one else. 6:3 And they compassed the city. i.e., Jericho. 6:3 Once a day. 6:3 They did thus for six days. i.e., perhaps they (people of the city) might submit without being destroyed. 6:4 And on the seventh day they compassed the city seven times. i.e., here was concluded the Sabbath by divine commandment. 6:5 All the people shall give a great shout, and the wall shall fall down. i.e., as the Mongols do nowadays when they conquer cities.

div.head: Chapter IV.
div.ab:
Chapter IV. 6:14 And they compassed the city. with pethaha of Kof and a vowelless Resh, and Qushshaya of the two kof. 6:14 They did thus the six days. with Qushshaya of the two Tau. 6:18 And you shall keep (yourselves) from the unlawful lest ye become accursed. i.e., Jericho was the first city they captured. For this reason they vowed to the Lord its spoil. 5:22 As you have sworn unto her with Hevasa of mim,
nest. with pethaha. 6:26 And Joshua swore at that time and said cursed be the man before the Lord that rises up and build this city Jericho. i.e., God gave her a chance seven days to repent, but did not repent. 6:26 By his first-born he shall found it, and by his youngest he shall set up its gates. i.e., Ahab the wicked king, when he ventured afterwards and laid its foundations, his first-born Abiram died and when he set up its gates his youngest son Sakhuth died. In Gr. this interpretation is joined to the text. 7:1 And akhar the son of Karmi, the son of Zavdi, the son of Zarh of the tribe of Judah took.... i.e., stole from the spoil. 7:2 ai which is beside Beth un. 7:7 And Joshua said un Lord God! i.e., O! Lord! 7:7 Wherefore hast thou brought this people over the Jordan. i.e., to show the nation that their victory was from God he was saying these things, and not simply to find fault.

div.head: Chapter V.
div.ab:
Chapter V. 7:13 Thus said the Lord........An accursed thing is in the midst of thee, Israel. Not again thou shalt be able to stand before thy enemies until you have taken away the accursed thing from among you. with pethaha of Tau. 7:14 And the tribe which the Lord takes shall come forward according to the families. Gr. kindreds. i.e., one tribe shall be taken out from among the tribes, and from among the tribe families, and from among the families' households, and from the latter, from the household, men, lest akhar should repent and lay down that which he stole and would not be burnt.
7:21 I saw among the spoil a Babylonian garment, and it was beautiful. Gr. a very colored garment. Aq. a goodly Babylonian stole. 7:21 And two hundred shekels of silver. Gr. Didrachma. Aq. shekels (but in Greek pronunciation). 7:21 And a tongue of gold that weighs 50 shekels. Aq. staters 7:25 Why hast thou deceived us. The Lord shall deceive thee this day. Gr. Why have you blotted us out, the Lord shall blot you out. 7:25 And he burned them with fire. i.e., him and all that belonged to him in order that the condemnation might be more terrible. 8:16 And they were withdrawn from the city. i.e., were removed afar.

div.head: Chapter VI.
div.ab:
Chapter VI. 9:3 And the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done to Ai and Jericho. 9:4 And they also did work wilily. i.e., for God loves those who repent. Because of that God did not reveal their schemes to Joshua the son of Nun. 9:4 And they lay old sacks on their asses. Gr. upon their shoulders. 9:4 And wine-skins old, rent, and bound up. i.e., from bundles. 9:5 And old sandals. Gr. and their sandals old. 9:5 having (wearing) sandals with Hevasa of Mim, nest. with Zeqafa. i.e., untanned skin which is not good. Gr. and soles on their feet. 9:5 And the bread of their provisions dried up and had mould on it. Gr. dried up and crumbled. i.e., All this, the Gibeonites did that they might find more pity (favor) as those that had come from a far place to seek a covenant. 9:14 And these men took their provisions and went away. i.e., the chiefs of the children of Israel took the provisions of the Gibeonites as if receiving them.
And They went has no meaning here, but in Gr. it is found. 9:14 And from the mouth of the Lord they did not ask. with Revasa of Shin. i.e., the chiefs of Israel, and it was for this reason the fraud was obscured from them.

div.head: Chapter VII.
div.ab: Chapter VII. 9:15 And the chiefs of the congregation swore for them. with Hevasa of Mim and in some codex with pethaha. 9:17 And the names of their villages were Giv un and Kefira and iruth and Quryath Na rin. 9:18 And they did not kill them. with pethaha of Qof. 9:19 We swore for them. with Hevasa of Mim, nest. with pethaha. 9:21 And the chiefs of the sons of Israel said, they shall live, but shall be gathering wood and filling water for all the congregation. 9:23 Now therefore ye shall be cursed. i.e., because they were murmuring and clamouring.

He cursed them with the mouth and not from the heart. 9:23 And there shall not be wanting from among you the man that gathers wood and draws water to the house of the Lord. Gr. for me and for my God. 10:3 Adhunisdaq, king of Jerusalem, sent unto Huham, king of Hivran, and unto Baran, king of Yarmuth, and unto Nafi, king of Lakhish, and unto Davir, king of Eglun. 10:6 Slack not thy hand from thy servants. With pethaha of Tau. 10:10 And smote them until aqar and unto Maqar. 10:12 Sun, remain thou upon Gibeon, and thou moon in the valley of. i.e., they were expecting to humiliate those of gods
(meaning polytheists). 10:13 Behold it is written in the book of praises. i.e., in that book of the triumphants (or victories). Gr. Is not that written in the book of the upright. 10:13 And it was as a whole day. i.e., its hours were not increased (meaning in number) but were lengthened.

div.head: Chapter VIII.
div.ab: Chapter VIII 10:20 And when Joshua and the children of Israel had made an end of with pathaha of Gamal. Slaying them with a great slaughter Gr. mutilating them in a great slaughter. 10:20 until they were consumed with a vowelless Gamal. 10:20 And they made the rebels of Gibeon enter their fortified cities. with pethaha of Mim. i.e., those that rebelled against their kings and adhered to Israel. 10:26 And after that Joshua smote them, and hang them on five pieces of wood. i.e., After the princes had placed their feet on the neck of those five kings. 10:33 Then Harman, king of Gadhar came up. 10:32 And smote it with the edge of the sword. with Qushshaya of Beth. 11:1 When Navin, king of Hasur heard, he sent to Yuvan, king of Marun. with pethaha of Mim, nest. with Revasa. 11:1 And unto the king of Akhshaf. 11:2 And in the plain of Kinrath..... and Banpeth-dur.

div.head: Chapter IX.
div.ab:
Chapter IX. 11:13 And all the villages that stand on the hills. Sim. that stand firm. Theod. - that are fortified. 11:13 Israel burned them Gr. Joshua did not burn. 11:20 That they might smite them. with Revasa of Nun. 12:9 And then are the kings of the land which
Joshua smote. i.e., thirty one kings (cf. 12:24) 12:9 One king of Jericho, 12:9 of Ai 12:10 of Jerusalem 12:10 of Hivrun 12:11 of Yarmuth 12:11 of Lakhish 12:12 of Iglun 12:12 of Gazar 12:13 of Davir.....of Hirma. 12:14 of Gadhar.....of Adhar. 12:15 of Livna..... of arlam. 12:16 of Magar.....of Beth el. 12:17 of Tafuh....of Hafar. 12:18 of Afaq..... of Nishrun. 12:19 of Marun.....of Hasur. 12:20 of Shumrin.....of Akhshaf. 12:20 of Ta nakh.....of Magdul 12:21 of Raqem.....of Neqim am and of Karmla. 12:22 of Dur and of Nafithdur....and of umqa and of Galgala. 12:24 of Tarsa.

div.head: Chapter X.
div.ab:
Chapter X. 13:2 This is the land that had remained in all the circuit of Palestine. Gr. the boundary of Palestine. 13:2 And in all the place of Ain-dur Gr. and in all of Gashur. 13:3 And from Shihar which is before Egypt. Gr. from the uninhabitable land which is before Egypt. 13:3 The five lords of the Philistines. Gr. five satraps of the Philistines. 13:3 The Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, and the Eshkalonites, and the Gittites, and the Ekronites, and the Avites. 13:6 And until the place of the hot springs. Heb. (hot, burning waters). 13:11 And the boundary of ʿindur, and of Quras.
13:17 And Rivun and Methbe el Gr. Bemuth Ba la. 13:18 And
Yahas and Qirmuth and enath. 13:19 And Quryathim and Shamsha and Yasrath. 13:20 And Beth-pe ur and esruth and Pasga and Beth Ahshemath. 13:21 to uwi and to Raqem and to Sur and to and Rava .

div.head: Chapter XI.
div.ab:
Chapter XI. 14:15 And the name of Hebron was previously Karka, the village of Arba of mighty men. i.e., It was called Karka because it had a wall, and village of Arba because four men ruled over it; and because of its greatness and fortification it was given an inheritance to Kalav the son of Yufana. And unto the tribe of Judah:-- 15:3 eqarqam.....Sin.....Hisruth..... Edhar.....Qarqa. 15:4 esmun 15:7 Lavan.....Ramin,.....Shemesh..... aina of Dughel. 15:8 The valley of the son of Hinnom. 15:9 Naftuh 15:10 Kishlun 15:11 Shikhrun.....Yahba el 15:12 Meriva 15:14 Shishai.....Ahiman.....Tulmai. 15:16 And Kalav said, he that conquers the village Safra Gr. the city of writing. 15:16 and destroy it with Revasa of Nun. i.e., with the sword. 15:16 I shall give him Aksa my daughter as wife. 15:17 And Athnu el the son of Qanaz the brother of Kalav conquered it, 15:19 Give me a blessing, because in the land of the South you have given to me. i.e., they are lacking in water. 15:19 Give me a well here. Gr. 15:21 The names of the villages of the children of Judah, Qavsi el, Adhar,.....Yaghur 15:22 Qina, Yarmuna Gadhgadha. 15:23 Qedhesh, Hasur, Nathnin.
15:24 Ziv, Atlam, Be luth. 15:25 And Hasur, and Hadhatha. 15:26 And Amam and Shama and Mauledha. 15:27 And Hasar Adha and Hishmun, and Beth pelat. 15:28 And Darath Ta le, and Bir Sheva, and Bir Yuthana. 15:29 And Be el and elyan and Asam. 15:30 And Altelam, and Akhsim and Hirnia. 15:31 And Sinqlagh, and Marmana, and Samsala. 15:32 And Lavuth, and Shaluh, and irmun.

div.ab:

16:2 etruth. 16:3 Palta.....Hawran.....Gadhar 16:5 Edhar 16:6 Shila.....yaluh 16:7 etruth.....Yagrath.....Pagar, Iriha 16:8 The valley of Gave 17:2 Aviazar.....Halaq....Nishra el...Shufam.....Hafar..... Shemidha 17:7 Tafuh 17:8 And Petah 17:11 Yashan....and Nevl am.... and aindur.....and Ta nakh.

div.head: Chapter XIII.
div.ab:
Chapter XIII. 17:14 For is it until now that the Lord has blessed us? i.e., it is read as a question, for indeed, said the children of Yusuf, in addition to one lot and one portion of land, we need a blessing from God, because we are numerous nation. 18:1 And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled in Shila, and there set up a tabernacle. i.e., Shila was not Jerusalem. It is known by the fact that Shila was a devastation at that time while Jerusalem was propperous. 18:6 And I shall show you the lot chosen before the Lord. Gr. and I shall cast a lot for you before the Lord. 18:10 And they cast for themselves lots in Shila before the Lord. i.e., portions of land. Gr.
( ) lots i.e., 18:17 Ramin.....Lavan.....Bahan And Zavith 18:19 And Hagla 18:21 And Amaq and Qasas 18:22 arava and Samrin 18:23 And ayan and Para and ufra. 18:24 And afli and Genao 18:25 And Gin un and Ramath and Barwa 18:26 And Maspa and Kefira and Masa 18:27 And Reqem and Rafu el and Tar ala 18:28 And Sala and Gavira and Yahhus which is Jerusalem. And Giv ath and Quryathim. 19:2 Bir Shena and Shava and Mawlda 19:3 And Darath-Ta le and Bala And esam 19:4 And Aluthladh 19:5 And Beth Markibuth and Hasar Susa. 19:6 And Beth Labbuth and Sharwainan 19:7 And ayin and Ramin, and Gathar and eshan 19:8 until Be ath

div.head: Chapter XIV.
div.ab:
Chapter XIV. 19:11 And he arrived at Divshath. 19:11 Neqim am 19:12 At the boundary of Kisluth, and of Bathar. 19:12 To ravath.....to Nafi 19:13 and unto Gath and unto Hafar, and unto atha, and unto Qisyan..... and unto Mathwa, and unto Lawa. 19:14 To the north of Hadhithan. 19:14 To the valley of aftena el. 19:15 And to Qalath, and to Yahlil and to Shomrin and to ar ala and to Beth-Lehem 19:18 Izrael and Kisluth and Shu im. 19:19 And Hafiram and Shen an and aʿtar 19:20 And Divlath, and Qishun and afas 19:21 And Ramath in and enyan, and in Hadha and Beth Pesyan. 19:22 In Tur and in Shahsima, and in Beth Shemesh. 19:25 Haqlath,
and Hali and Batan and Akhshaf 19:26 And Amlekh and amkar and Masha el....and Shihar and Labbith 19:27 To the house of Daghan.....and Nafteha el..... and Davith.....and Din a el.....Kuval 19:28 And to ivran and to Rahav and to Hamun and to Ta a until Saidun the great. 19:29 To Has Yarav 19:29 And Afaq Rahuv 19:33 Halpa.... 19:44 And Alqath and Gintun and Bi lath 19:45 And Ihudith and Ba eldhbakh, and Githrmun 19:49 And Mahrequn and Kirqun.....which is opposite Alath 19:47 And they called it Linawdan 19:49 And they finished inheriting the land 19:50 To Tamnath Sarah 20:4 And they shall take him up to themselves in the village Gr. And they shall return him. Sim. and they shall bring him.

div.head: Chapter XV.
div.ab:
Chapter XV. 21:13 To
Hivran 21:14 To Yarath..... and to Ishtmu 21:15 And to Halul....and to Davir 21:16 And to in....and to ata.... and to Beth Shemesh 21:18 And to ontuth.....and ilmun 21:22 To Masim These are the villages of their lot. 21:23 Athleqa....and Givtun 21:24 And Alun....and Gathermun 21:27 Gawlan 21:30 Ekhrun.....Halquth 21:31 Rahuv 21:32 Himrun.....Qartan 21:34 Qaryathim 21:35 Ashhmuth 21:36 Navah....Qartan 21:37 Romin.....Yahla 21:40 And came up in their lot

div.head: Chapter XVI.
div.ab: Chapter XVI. 22:26and27 Because of this we said let us make for ourselves a place, and build us an altar not for sacrifice or offering, but for witness. i.e., that we are the Lord's. This is an apology which the children of Ruvil and the children of Gadh gave. And half the tribe of Manassah were prosecuted (accused) by the chiefs of the congregation because they built an altar outside Jerusalem before they crossed the Jordan.

div.head: Chapter XVII.
div.ab: Chapter XVII. 23:14 That not one word ceased Gr. did not fall. 24:3 And led him (Made him walk) in all the land of Kanaan Gr. Led him.

div.head: Chapter XVIII.
div.ab:
Chapter XVIII. 24:26 And he took a large rock and set it up under the terebinth tree (pistacio terebinthus) Sim. under the oak tree. 24:27 This rock shall be a witness unto us. Gr. as a witness. 24:27 Because it had heard all the words of
the Lord which he spoke to us. i.e., It was not the stone that heard, but in a divine manner he said thus. 24:30 North of the mountain of Ga ash with Zeqafa of ain nest. with Revasa. i.e., where Joshua the Son of Nun was buried. 24:33 And they buried him in Gin ath of Pinhas his son with Revasa of Gamal nest. with a vowelless Gamal, and Pethaha of Beth. The book of Joshua the son of Nun finished.
